'''Nogometni klub Osijek''' ({{langx|en|Osijek Football Club}}), commonly referred to as '''NK Osijek''' ({{IPA|hr|ôsijeːk}}), is a Croatian professional [[association football|football]] club from [[Osijek]]. They compete in the [[Croatian Football League]] (HNL), the top tier of [[Croatian football league system|Croatian football]]. Founded in 1947, it was the club from [[Slavonia]] with the most seasons in the [[Yugoslav First League]] and, after the [[independence of Croatia]] in 1992, it is one of the four clubs that have [[List of unrelegated association football clubs|never been relegated]] from the HNL, with the others being [[GNK Dinamo Zagreb|Dinamo Zagreb]], [[HNK Hajduk Split|Hajduk Split]] and [[HNK Rijeka|Rijeka]]."}}
